messages:
Lina Park: Quick design check \u2014 proposing a compact 'history crumbs' pattern for Deployments + safer revert UX. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ux-history (frame: history-crumbs) :eyes:

Samir Patel: Nice. How should keyboard users navigate? Tab might be noisy if each crumb opens a panel.

Aria Gomez: Recommend left/right arrow nav for crumbs, keep Tab for escaping. Use role=listbox+option or similar. SR text: 'Deployment history. Use left and right arrows to navigate. Press Enter for details.'

Jayden Wu: For A/B with many variants, collapse extras behind a '+N' chip. Hover shows preview. Click/Enter opens diff.

Kevin O'Neill: Microcopy: 'Promote' confuses people. Suggest 'Roll forward' for increasing traffic and 'Finalize' to publish.

Lina Park: Revert flow idea: inline undo toast (5s) + explicit 'Revert to snapshot' modal for full rollbacks. Fast but safe.

Samir Patel: Toast must be non-focus-stealing and announced politely: 'Deployment reverted. Undo available.'

Aria Gomez: Add aria-live only for status changes. Also include roledescription on crumb: 'Version 0.9.2, canary 10%'.

Jayden Wu: Interaction rule: do not auto-open diffs on hover. Tooltip delay ~300ms, show author, commit short, traffic %.

Lina Park: Add a one-line diff summary in each crumb like '+2 prompts, -1 param' so PMs get quick context.

Kevin O'Neill: Accessibility/color: status pills need icons or shape + improved contrast for color-blind users. Add small left glyph and label.

ux-bot: history-crumbs updated \u2014 preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood/history-crumbs (build 709) :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Also add a 'Go to latest' button at start of crumbs with an aria-label for keyboard users.

Aria Gomez: Ensure focus order: Go-to-latest -> crumb list -> actions. SR announces current selection and state.

Lina Park: Next steps: Jayden \u2014 implement collapse '+N' + tooltip delay. Aria \u2014 finalize SR strings and aria attributes. Kevin \u2014 update CTAs and icons. Samir \u2014 prototype arrow-key nav and tab order. I'll update Figma and loop back. :thumbsup:

Jayden Wu: On it.

Aria Gomez: Posting SR text by EOD.

Kevin O'Neill: Mocking icons now.

Lina Park: Thanks team, let's keep this async unless blockers.
